Ported @/lib/dateFormat formatter logic byte-for-byte (only the 8 imported by this hook + their transitive helpers intlOpts/intlLocale/getFormatter+FORMATTER_CACHE/ymdInTz/parseYmdToUtcMillis/daysBetweenYmd): the '\u2014' placeholder for nullish/invalid input, the isNaN guards (and the deliberate ABSENCE of one in formatRelativeTime, matching web L257-268), formatRelative's fallback to libFormatDate, and formatRelativeDays' tz-anchored day math (Today/Yesterday/in Nd/Nd/Nw/Nmo/Ny ago) are all identical. ymdInTz keeps the web try/catch so an Intl engine lacking timeZone/formatToParts degrades to the device-local day instead of throwing — the native-safe fallback. Native-safety: no DOM modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, or old web UI components are imported — only `react` (useCallback/useMemo) and the two native web-parity API hooks. Intl.* (toLocaleDateString/toLocaleTimeString/toLocaleString/DateTimeFormat/formatToParts/resolvedOptions) is the same API the already-converted native pages rely on; browserTimezone() catches a missing Intl and returns 'UTC'. Unit handling: none (this file formats dates only; SI cutover does not apply). i18n: the formatters emit the same literal English relative phrases ('just now'/'Just now'/'Today'/'Yesterday'/'Nm ago'/etc.) as the web source — intent preserved 1:1.

State/API-surface names retained 1:1 for callers: the exported useDateFormat(mode?: TzMode), DateFormatter, UseDateFormatResult, FormatOptions, and TzMode, plus the returned opts/tz/locale + formatDate/formatDateTime/formatTime/formatDateShort/formatDateWithDay/formatRelative/formatRelativeTime/formatRelativeDays.
